page2.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: Goa has earned global recognition as one of India's leading hospitality and tourism destinations.
Every day, thousands of professionals working in hotels, restaurants, bars, cafés, resorts, cruise lines, retail and tourism create memorable experiences for guests from around the world.

Yet many talented and hardworking individuals never have the opportunity to receive internationally recognised wine education; not because they lack ability, but because professional training remains financially out of reach.
Madhushala by Mata believes that talent should never be limited by circumstance.

Through the Madhushala By Mata Wine Education Scholarship Programme, we aim to provide deserving Goa’s students and hospitality professionals with access to internationally respected Wine & Spirit Education Trust (WSET) qualifications, helping them build rewarding careers both within Goa and across the global hospitality industry.
We invite visionary organisations and individuals to partner with us in creating the next generation of highly skilled hospitality professionals.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.text: To establish Goa as India's benchmark for internationally qualified hospitality professionals through accessible wine education.

about.heading: About Madhushala by Mata
paragraphs: Madhushala by Mata is Goa’s exclusive WSET approved programme provider & a specialist wine education academy dedicated to delivering internationally recognised WSET qualifications in a professional, inclusive and engaging learning environment.
Our mission extends beyond teaching wine.
We believe education creates opportunity.
By equipping individuals with globally recognised knowledge and qualifications, we help them become more confident professionals capable of representing Goa's hospitality industry with excellence.

Whether our students choose careers in luxury hotels, aviation, cruise lines, restaurants, wine trade, retail, tourism or international hospitality, our goal is to prepare them to compete confidently on a global stage.

founder.heading: Meet the Founder
founder.name: Manisha Tarcar
paragraphs: Manisha Tarcar brings together international education and practical beverage expertise developed through studies in wine, brewing and distilling in England.
Through Madhushala by Mata, her goal is to raise the standard of wine education in Goa by making internationally recognised education more accessible.
Having witnessed first-hand the value that structured wine education brings to hospitality professionals, she established Madhushala by Mata with a simple belief:
founder.pullQuote: Professional education has the power to transform careers and uplift an entire industry.

page4.heading: Why This Matters
paragraphs: Hospitality is one of Goa's largest employers.
Every year thousands of professionals interact with guests who increasingly expect knowledgeable recommendations and world-class service.
However, many talented individuals have never received structured wine education.
As a result they often:
bullets: Lack confidence discussing wines with guests.
Find it difficult to compete for international positions.
Have limited access to recognised professional qualifications.

page5.heading: The Scholarship Programme
paragraphs: The Madhushala By Mata Wine Education Scholarship Programme has been created to remove financial barriers that prevent deserving individuals from accessing world-class wine education.
Scholarships fully fund the student's WSET course; ensuring recipients receive exactly the same educational experience as every paying student.
We believe excellence should never be compromised.

page5.closing: Recipients are selected through a transparent application process based upon financial need, commitment and future potential.

page8.heading: Selection & Governance
intro: Scholarships are awarded through a transparent and merit-based selection process.

eligibility.heading: Proposed Scholarship Eligibility
eligibility.intro: To ensure the programme reaches those who genuinely need assistance, applicants should:
bullets: Be at least 18 years of age
Be a resident of Goa for a minimum of 5 years
Demonstrate financial need (parents income below 5-8 lakh per annum)
Have completed at least Class 12 (or equivalent)
If a student, be one of the top students in their respective college in the food & beverage programme.
If currently employed, seeking employment or pursuing a career in hospitality, tourism, aviation, cruise lines, food & beverage, retail, or related industries.
Submit a short statement explaining how the scholarship would help their career
Attend all classes and sit the WSET examination
Agree to maintain professional conduct throughout the course

conditions.heading: Some Conditions Apply
bullets: One scholarship per student for WSET Level 1 Award except if he/she passes with 100% marks can apply for scholarship for WSET Level 2 Award.
Preference for applicants who have not previously received funded professional certifications.

preference.heading: Preference May Be Given To
bullets: Hospitality professional applicants recommended by employers or hospitality associations
Persons working in small restaurants, cafés, beach shacks, hotels, wine retail or tourism

page8.closing: Sponsors may receive annual reports outlining programme impact while respecting recipient privacy.

page9.heading: Join Us in Building the Future of Hospitality
paragraphs: Every scholarship represents more than one student.
It represents:
representLines: A hospitality professional who discovers confidence.
A business that benefits from better-trained staff.
A guest who receives exceptional service.
closingParagraphs: Our long-term vision is to create Goa's most respected wine education scholarship programme, helping hundreds of hospitality professionals gain internationally recognised qualifications over the coming years.
By investing in internationally recognised wine education today, you are helping create opportunities that will benefit individuals, employers in the wine & hospitality industry for years to come.
We invite you to become a founding partner in this journey.
